name: Keep the goal through handoffs
purpose: Preserve the goal, constraints, evidence links and unfinished checks across resume and compaction.
mechanism: SessionStart + PreCompact guidance; validated project checkpoint
caveat: Instructions support retention; they do not prove compliance or create a semantic checkpoint automatically.

name: Bound successful tool output
purpose: Keep useful excerpts in context and preserve the full successful Bash result as an artifact.
caveat: Errors, interrupted calls, images and unknown result shapes remain unchanged. Character limit is not an exact token limit.

name: Capture traceable evidence
purpose: Record tool completion metadata and project artifact references without copying raw output into the trace.
mechanism: PostToolUse metadata recorder + validated result contract
caveat: A completed tool event does not by itself prove a QA acceptance check passed.

name: Coordinate a scoped QA workflow
purpose: Connect investigation, hypothesis, regression checks and verification with explicit inputs and outputs.
mechanism: /context-audit workflow + optional Haiku evidence / Sonnet review agents
caveat: Worker model suitability requires representative checks. Worker overhead can exceed any savings.

name: Measure the next sessions
purpose: Capture local lifecycle metadata and provide instructions for optional native OpenTelemetry collection.
mechanism: Local event recorder; explicit OTel setup instructions
caveat: No exporter destination or raw prompt logging is enabled. Historical missing telemetry cannot be recovered.
